title: Two Coworkers Two Replacement Faces
tests: Tests explicit multi-face mapping and stable identity tracking across a two-person video without changing the original scene or sound.

checks.name: stops asking within 3 rounds
got: I’m pausing the swap until I can view the faces reliably. You don’t need to choose the mappings yourself—just upload a screenshot of the office clip, and I’ll handle the matching.

faults.what: No face-swapped video was generated or delivered; the agent explicitly left the clip unchanged. The only tool outputs shown are detection crops of the original faces.

judge.summary: The agent stopped at face detection and delivered no edited video, leaving the requested two-face swap unfulfilled.

must_haves.item: The output contains the full 10-second office exchange from talk-two.mp4.
must_haves.why: No output video was delivered; detection crops do not contain the office exchange.

must_haves.item: The male coworker's face recognizably matches portrait-man.jpg and the female coworker's face recognizably matches portrait-woman.jpg.
must_haves.why: The visible detection crops retain the original identities, and the agent states that no swap was generated.

must_haves.item: The two replacement identities never switch between coworkers or collapse into the same face.
must_haves.why: Neither replacement identity was applied, so the required consistent two-identity replacement was not delivered.

must_haves.item: Both faces stay aligned through head turns and speaking, without conspicuous flickering or original-face reappearance.
must_haves.why: There is no edited moving footage to assess alignment or temporal stability.

must_haves.item: The original office, camera movement and shot timing remain; the two people's hair and clothing may follow their portraits so they are recognisable.
must_haves.why: The source frame and detection crops show the office, but no delivered video allows verification of preserved camera movement and timing.

must_haves.item: Both original voices remain audible and synchronized, with no added music or narration.
must_haves.why: No playable output with audio is provided.
